name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Fix jax.scipy.signal.stft, csd and welch with a callable detrend

head_commit.message:
Fix jax.scipy.signal.stft, csd and welch with a callable detrend

A callable detrend was passed segments of shape (nperseg, nseg) instead of
(nseg, nperseg) as in scipy.signal. A detrend that subtracts each segment's
mean therefore subtracted across segments, giving nonzero DC terms where
SciPy returns zeros.

The axis was canonicalized before being compared with -1, so the wrapper
that reshapes segments for the callable always ran, and it moved the axes
in the opposite direction from SciPy. Compare the axis as passed and move
the axes as SciPy does.

Fixes #42599

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Fix the JVP of pivoted QR for wide matrices

head_commit.message:
Fix the JVP of pivoted QR for wide matrices

For m < n the JVP computes dR2 = dQ^H X2 + Q^H dX2, where X2 holds the
trailing columns of X. With pivoting, Q R = X P, so X2 must come from
the permuted matrix like dX does. Using the unpermuted X gave wrong
derivatives for the trailing columns of R.

Also run the JVP check in testScipyQrModes for all pivoting cases
except mode='r'.

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Slice free mesh axes before reducing unreduced axes in `jax.reshard`

head_commit.message:
Slice free mesh axes before reducing unreduced axes in `jax.reshard`

When `jax.reshard` reduces `unreduced` axes and the target sharding adds mesh
axes that the input doesn't use yet, slice the input on those axes before the
reduction instead of raising `NotImplementedError`. The slice needs no
communication, and the `all_reduce` / `reduce_scatter` after it moves less
data.

```
f32[4, 4]{U:x} -> f32[4, 4@y]:      slice 'y', then all_reduce 'x'
f32[4, 4]{U:x} -> f32[4@(y, x), 4]: slice 'y', then reduce_scatter 'x'
```

This reuses `_free_slice_axes` from the reshard planner. Targets that need
other reshards (for example `f32[4@(x, y), 4]`, where 'y' comes after the
reduced axis 'x') still raise `NotImplementedError`.

Also trim the `jax.random` sharding tests in pjit_test.py to two small tests,
which cuts the runtime of `pjit_test` a lot.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1022018338

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: [JAX] Use the new XLA autotuner cache flags for the persistent compilation cache.

head_commit.message:
[JAX] Use the new XLA autotuner cache flags for the persistent compilation cache.

XLA deprecated `xla_gpu_per_fusion_autotune_cache_dir` and `xla_gpu_experimental_autotune_cache_mode` in favor of backend-neutral `xla_autotune_cache_dir` and `xla_autotune_cache_mode`.

Expose the new autotune cache `DebugOptions` fields in jaxlib and bump `jaxlib_extension_version` to 523. When jaxlib is new enough, JAX's persistent compilation cache now sets the new fields, and the cache key ignores them (both in `DebugOptions` and in `XLA_FLAGS`) the same way it already ignores the deprecated ones, so users switching to the new flags don't get cache misses. Older jaxlib versions keep using the deprecated fields.

The on-disk subdirectory name and the `jax_persistent_cache_enable_xla_caches` option values are unchanged, so existing caches and configurations keep working.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1012576594

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: [jax-buildcop] Reduce concurrent test jobs on single-B200 CI job from…

head_commit.message:
[jax-buildcop] Reduce concurrent test jobs on single-B200 CI job from 8 to 4.

`Bazel single B200 CUDA tests` in `bazel_cuda_h100_b200.yml` runs on a single-GPU B200 VM (`linux-x86-a4-224-b200-1gpu`) with `JAXCI_LOCAL_TEST_JOBS=8` and `JAXCI_TESTS_PER_ACCELERATOR=8` (default), multiplexing 8 concurrent test processes onto the single B200 GPU. Under 8-way GPU contention, the slowest shards of `//tests/pallas:mosaic_gpu_test_gpu` (~140s on an uncontended B200) slow down ~3x and hit the 420s timeout (`JAXCI_TEST_TIMEOUT=420`).

Reduce `JAXCI_LOCAL_TEST_JOBS` and `JAXCI_TESTS_PER_ACCELERATOR` from 8 to 4 to reduce single-GPU contention and shard timeouts.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1022342308
